purpose.zh: 练肩部推举力量，斜线推对肩更友好
purpose.en: Build shoulder pressing strength on a shoulder-friendly angle.

text.zh: 斜向前上方推到手臂伸直，最后肩胛向前送
text.en: Press up and forward until your arm is straight, then reach a little further

text.zh: 收紧臀部和腹部，躯干不后仰
text.en: Squeeze your glutes and abs and keep your trunk from leaning back.
Lower slowly back to the front of your shoulder.

commonErrors.en: Arching the lower back to help the press.

cautions.zh: 肩前侧夹痛时缩小幅度或换简单版本
cautions.en: If the front of your shoulder pinches, reduce the range or switch to an easier version.
